newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-HUMPHREYS WILL MISS U.S. CLASH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-HUMPHREYS WILL MISS U.S. CLASH.

text.p: Wales captain Jonathan Humphreys was banned for seven days after he was sent off on Sunday and will miss next weekend's international against the U.S.Eagles in Cardiff.

But Cardiff have lodged an appeal against the suspension, imposed by a specially-appointed match commissioner following the hooker's dismissal in a 26-13 European Cup semifinal defeat in Brive, France.

Humphreys, who has led his country 13 times, was sent off in the 53rd minute for tackling Brive scrum-half Philippe Carbonneau after not retreating 10 metres from a tap penalty -- effectively a professional foul.
Irish referee Brian Stirling had earlier cautioned Humphreys following a first half flare-up involving both sets of forwards.
But Humphreys will be available for the Wales Five Nations Championship opener against Scotland in Edinburgh on January 18.
